functions.name: CONVERT
functions.description: Converts a number between units with an exact factor. A unit that is unknown or ambiguous is an error, never a guess.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unit to convert from, for example km/h.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unit to convert to, for example m/s.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: Optional, only for mass to volume (or back): your own density, for example 998.2067kg/m3, or the name of a density in a loaded config such as water_25C (needs config water). Ignored when no density is needed. Nothing is assumed when it is left out.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional: a shipped config that resolves names which are otherwise refused as ambiguous, for example us (ton, mile, gal), gb, metric-trade, year-julian, year-civil, or water for its densities. Several: us,water.

functions.name: CONVERTEXACT
functions.description: Like CONVERT, but the value may be text with pi, kept exact: "4pi", "pi/2", "2*pi^2", or a decimal such as "0.1". Allows * / ^ and parentheses, no addition. Rounded once at the end. A unit or expression that is unknown or ambiguous is an error, never a guess.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to convert: a number, or text such as "4pi" or "pi/2". Write 1/(2*pi), not 1/2pi (ambiguous, refused).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unit to convert from, for example rad.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unit to convert to, for example deg.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: Optional, only for mass to volume (or back): your own density, for example 998.2067kg/m3, or the name of a density in a loaded config such as water_25C (needs config water). Ignored when no density is needed. Nothing is assumed when it is left out.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional: a shipped config that resolves names which are otherwise refused as ambiguous, for example us (ton, mile, gal), gb, metric-trade, year-julian, year-civil, or water for its densities. Several: us,water.

functions.name: CONVERTRANGE
functions.description: Converts every number in a range between units with one exact factor, and spills the results. Blank cells stay blank; a cell with text is an error that names its position. A unit that is unknown or ambiguous is an error, never a guess.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The range of numbers to convert. Blank cells (or cells with only spaces) stay blank.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unit to convert from, for example km/h.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unit to convert to, for example m/s.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: Optional, only for mass to volume (or back): your own density, for example 998.2067kg/m3, or the name of a density in a loaded config such as water_25C (needs config water). Ignored when no density is needed. Nothing is assumed when it is left out.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional: a shipped config that resolves names which are otherwise refused as ambiguous, for example us (ton, mile, gal), gb, metric-trade, year-julian, year-civil, or water for its densities. Several: us,water.

functions.name: VERSION
functions.description: The unit table version and the number of units.
